---
title: "Agent Skills"
---

captain-hook bundles two Claude Code [Agent Skills](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/skills) that automate adoption. One surveys a repository and sets up hooks from its conventions, and the other translates a prose style guide into enforced rules. Both ship in the PyPI wheel and as a Claude Code plugin, from the same source.

- `bootstrapping-hooks` surveys your repo's docs, CI workflows, lint configs, and git history, proposes categorized gates and nudges for your approval, then writes `.claude/hooks/*.py` with inline tests, verifies them with `uvx capt-hook test`, and wires `.claude/settings.json`.
- `translating-styleguides` turns a STYLEGUIDE.md, or the style sections of CONTRIBUTING/AGENTS/CLAUDE.md, into `StyleRule` classes, custom validation logic, or LLM hooks. It tiers each rule by what it needs and reports anything it can't enforce.

## Install with the CLI

Run either command from your project root:

```bash
uvx capt-hook init                  # scaffolds hooks AND registers the plugin
uvx capt-hook skills install        # registers the plugin only
```

Both write the captain-hook plugin into your committed `.claude/settings.json` as an `extraKnownMarketplaces` entry pointing at this repository plus an `enabledPlugins` entry that turns it on. Claude Code prompts you to install the plugin when you accept workspace trust. The skills then load from the plugin instead of being copied into your repo, so they track the repository and pick up every new commit. Invoke them as `/captain-hook:bootstrapping-hooks` and `/captain-hook:translating-styleguides`, or ask in plain language such as "set up captain hook" or "enforce our style guide". The plugin also ships `scanning-sessions` and `authoring-hooks`, which power the [session reviewer](../guide/session-reviewer.qmd); you do not invoke those directly.

In an interactive terminal, `init` finishes by offering to launch Claude with the bootstrapping skill right away. Accept and the survey-propose-write loop starts in your repo, with the bundled plugin loaded directly so the skill resolves before the marketplace install completes.

## Install from inside Claude Code

Already in a session? Add the marketplace and install the plugin by hand:

```
/plugin marketplace add yasyf/captain-hook
/plugin install captain-hook@captain-hook
```

Plugin skills are namespaced as `/captain-hook:bootstrapping-hooks`. Each commit is treated as a new version, so updates arrive without a PyPI release.

## What's inside

Each skill bundles a `SKILL.md` plus `references/` files that it loads on demand, covering API tables, a pattern catalog, the matcher reference, and a tier-classification rubric. To read the full skill bodies, see the [Agent Skills reference](../reference/skills.qmd).
